svg.title: Buy Now Pay Later, end to end
svg.desc: I own the journey with a junior PO: sign-up, instalments at checkout, statements, repayment, refunds, collection and activation. 60% of credit sat unused, so activation came first. CIMB live, VietCredit pilot Nov 2026, VPBank next. Lending · every step with the lender, Risk, Legal and Compliance.
